map.输入建材关键性能指标，按GB/T标准判定质量等级并生成可追溯检测报告: Input key building-material performance metrics; judge the quality grade per GB/T standards and generate a traceable test report.
map.本工具依据 GB/T 175（通用水泥）、GB/T 50081（混凝土）、GB/: This tool, per GB/T 175 (general cement), GB/T 50081 (concrete), GB/T 5101 (fired brick), GB/T 11968 (block) and others, automatically judges the quality grade (premium/first-class/qualified/unqualified) from input compressive and flexural strengths, and generates a traceable test report with batch number. Judgment and calculation run locally in the browser; data is not uploaded.

map.生成含批次编号的检测记录，便于质量追溯。: Generate test records with batch numbers for quality traceability.
map.建材类型选「混凝土」，批号 BM-2026-001，抗压强度 42.5 MPa、: Material type "Concrete", batch BM-2026-001, compressive 42.5 MPa, flexural 7.5 MPa. Concrete limits: compressive 30.0, flexural 4.0, both pass; and since 42.5 >= 30.0x1.3=39.0, judged premium, standard GB/T 50081.
map.建材类型选「烧结砖」，抗压强度 12.0 MPa、抗折强度 3.2 MPa。烧结: Material type "Fired brick", compressive 12.0 MPa, flexural 3.2 MPa. Fired-brick limits: compressive 15.0, flexural 3.0, flexural passes but compressive 12.0 < 15.0 fails, judged unqualified directly, prompting rectification.
map.先要求抗压与抗折两项都达到对应限值（合格），在此基础上若抗压强度还达到限值的 1: First require both compressive and flexural to meet limits (qualified); on that basis, premium only if compressive reaches >=1.3x the limit; only both qualified -> first-class. Limits differ by material: general cement 32.5/5.0, concrete 30.0/4.0, fired brick 15.0/3.0, block 5.0/1.0 MPa.
map.执行的标准为什么随材料类型变？: Why does the applied standard change with material type?
map.不同建材有各自的国家标准：通用水泥用 GB/T 175，混凝土用 GB/T 50: Different building materials have their own national standards: general cement GB/T 175, concrete GB/T 50081, fired brick GB/T 5101, block GB/T 11968. After selecting the material type the tool auto-switches to the matching standard and limits, avoiding misjudgment from wrong-standard application.
map.通用水泥按GB/T 175检测，混凝土按GB/T 50081，烧结砖按GB/T: General cement per GB/T 175, concrete per GB/T 50081, fired brick per GB/T 5101

map.不合格品应隔离存放并标识，不得用于工程: Unqualified products should be isolated and labeled, not used in works
